summary: Agnico Eagle Mines filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing a press release that only schedules the release of its third quarter 2026 results for October 28, 2026, and a related conference call and webcast for October 29, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. EDT. No transaction, shareholder vote, or corporate action is announced; no terms, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed. This is a routine earnings-timing notice, the US equivalent of an 8-K investor-relations scheduling filing, with no special-situations or risk-arb angle to watch.
